title: FishingbotServerside
description: This is the Server side (Spigot/Paper/Purpur + now Fabric (server)) counterpart to the Fabric version of Fishingbot!
body:
![Gif of me fishing ona server till theres only 2 durability left at which point the plugin stops autofishing](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/5c851c4c827a47b2420cbfc061be4016f223a18d.gif)
# FishingbotServerside

Have you been searching for a no-fuss, **server-side** auto-fishing plugin?

**FishingbotServerside** is here; an effortless, just-works plugin for **Automated AFK Fishing** on **Spigot, Paper, Purpur, (and now) Fabric (server) and more**!

No complicated setups, no client-side mods; just simple, reliable, and hands-free fishing, **that just works - with a single plugin on the server**.

**Commands:**
- `/autofish` (aliases: `/fishingbot`, `/togglefish`) – Toggle auto-fishing on and off.
- `/fbversion` – Check the plugin version.

**Permissions:**
- `fishingbot.use` – Allows players to use auto-fishing (default: **true**).

Ready to lean back and reel in the rewards (hjeh hjeh)? This is it!

![bstats graph that shows servers and players](https://bstats.org/signatures/bukkit/ServersideFishingbot.svg)
